description: Disambiguate a city, country, abbreviation, or timezone before calling other tools. Use this when a lookup is unknown or ambiguous, then retry get_current_time, convert_time, or find_meeting_time with candidate.suggestedQuery, candidate.suggestedId, or countryCode. This does not return the current time.

_endUserId.description: Optional opaque per-call end-user attribution token populated by the MCP host, not the LLM. Use a non-PII hash or token; never send raw email, name, or platform user ID.

candidateLimit.description: Page size for namesake candidates. Default 6. Follow moreCandidates.resolve or moreCandidates.search for the rest.

candidateOffset.description: Skip this many namesake candidates. Copy from moreCandidates.candidateOffset.

countryCode.description: Optional ISO country hint used for ranking and disambiguation. This is not a strict filter.

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

query.description: Search term such as "Victoria", "Sao Paulo", or "Tokyo".

name: search_timezones
